outcome: anxiety (classified into low anxiety, high anxiety, worried about the fetus, worried about delivery)
cohort: The study included 215 GDM patients admitted to a Grade III-A general hospital.
finding: Anxiety in GDM patients was categorized into four potential classes: low anxiety (54%), high anxiety (21%), worried about the fetus (11%), and worried about delivery (14%).
mod_finding: Delivery mode schedule was independently associated with high anxiety, worried about the fetus, and worried about delivery categories.
